03 / Decisions & evidence

Behind the experience.

Approach & boundaries

The code stores records in local SQLite, syncs with Google services, and sends interaction content to OpenAI for summaries. Enrichment sends contact identifiers to Exa and uses OpenAI for extraction and optional web search. Local storage does not mean all processing stays on the device.

Next.jsTypeScriptSQLiteGoogle APIsOpenAIExa

What the evidence shows

The public source implements ingestion, summaries, warmth scoring, enrichment, and reminders. This case study uses fictional contacts only; no private database or correspondence is included.
